verdict.rationale: Community evidence shows GitHub access was originally all-or-nothing full read-write to the entire account (comm-4, comm-5, comm-6), which the vendor acknowledged and then fixed by moving to a GitHub App with fine-grained repository permissions (comm-13, comm-14). This shows some ability to scope external tool/integration access, but there is no first-party documentation of a broader admin/engineering-lead control panel for restricting which MCP servers, subscriptions, or coding-agent integrations (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, etc.) are allowed. Missing for 10: documented org-wide policy controls, granular allow/deny lists for MCP servers or agent integrations, and independent confirmation beyond the GitHub permission fix.
